The '''Imperial Masticator''' was a small, spherical design of construction [[Starship/Legends|craft]] that was developed by the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]] to assist with the assembly of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] and the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] battlestation in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. The vessels were a refinement of an old [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[masticator]] design and were employed to break down [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and smelt them into [[Ore/Legends|ore]], which would then be pressed out by the masticators to form [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plates. In order to maximize the masticators' effectiveness, Lemelisk engineered the spheres so that they themselves could be easily dismantled and melted down for use in the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] construction.
